notes: Every name invented by the narrative stream, with the WORLD_BIBLE §5 rule it follows. Data, not prose: kept in the pack so a later pass can diff new names against it and so tools/namegen.py --check has a roster to compare. 'derivation' cites the roots and suffixes in §5.1-5.4.

rows.name: Wren Tallow
rows.derivation: bible example, §5.1

rows.name: Osric Pennywort
rows.derivation: bible example, §5.1

rows.name: Winnow Pennywort
rows.derivation: winnow (a mill word), family surname Pennywort = penny 'small'

rows.name: Hallam Ashdown
rows.derivation: hal- + -am; surname ash + -down, bible example

rows.name: Maud Brambling
rows.derivation: bible example, §5.1

rows.name: Tobin Cresswell
rows.derivation: Tobin (§5.1 first names); surname cress + -well

rows.name: Nell Harebell
rows.rule: 5.1 people; surname from two Valish roots
rows.derivation: hare + bell

rows.name: Corwen Mullard
rows.derivation: cor- + -en; surname Mullard from mull 'soft soil'

rows.name: Bessa Tamwick
rows.derivation: surname is the hamlet Tamwick (tam 'oak' + -wick)

rows.name: Robin Ashdown
rows.derivation: bird-name first name; father's surname

rows.name: Ellard Wynstead
rows.derivation: surname wyn 'meadow' + -stead

rows.name: Merrick Gosling
rows.derivation: merrow 'calm water' shortened + -ick; surname gos 'goose' + -ling

rows.name: Hesta Hollins
rows.derivation: surname from hollin 'holly'

rows.name: Pellam Ashcombe
rows.derivation: pell- + -am; surname ash + -combe

rows.name: Tam Hollins
rows.derivation: tam 'oak'; Hesta's late husband, named in dialogue only

rows.name: Aldith Sulion
rows.derivation: surname sul 'light' + -ion, an Oroth ending on a Tollmere family

rows.name: Bennick Cresswell
rows.derivation: Merrowby-born; cousin to Tobin Cresswell

rows.name: Ismay Ondrael
rows.derivation: ondr 'deep' + -ael; taken from a ruin by her mother's people, as the book says

rows.name: Tamsin Wick
rows.rule: 5.1 people; surname from a place suffix
rows.derivation: -wick 'dwelling' used bare as a surname

rows.name: Orrin Quill
rows.derivation: Quill, a clerk's trade name

rows.name: Aud Fennick
rows.rule: 5.1 people: masculine/neutral -ick used for a woman, per 'many names are used for anyone'
rows.derivation: surname from fenn

rows.name: Alder Wyke
rows.rule: 3.5 Woodfolk: Valish dialect with old roots
rows.derivation: alder (tree); Wyke, an older spelling of -wick

rows.name: Cadwen Ash
rows.rule: 5.1 people: -en; second name is a taken order-name, not a family name
rows.derivation: cad 'hill' + -en; 'Ash' sworn at Pilgrim's Ash

rows.name: Half-Ell
rows.rule: deliberate breach: the Quiet Hands do not use names (4, 5.1)
rows.derivation: a cloth measure; a by-name standing where a name was given up

rows.name: Tallissa Oul
rows.rule: 5.4: soft, sibilant, vowel-final, doubled consonants for length
rows.derivation: tal 'patience' + -lissa (cf. lissa 'reed'); Oul 'deep pool'

rows.name: Sa'oul
rows.rule: 5.4: the glottal apostrophe appears only in names of the drowned
rows.derivation: bible example; named in the Isseva round

rows.name: Tessane
rows.derivation: the Sayer of the Tide whom the Circle unsaid in Y.T. 941; a Sedgish name in a Tollmere institution, which is the point of her

rows.name: Dunna ko-Kharrow
rows.rule: 5.3: ko- 'child of' before the clan name; short, stress first
rows.derivation: dun 'remembered' + -na; Clan Kharrow

rows.name: Brann ko-Kharrow
rows.derivation: bible example first name, Kharrow clan; sung in the Rope-Song

rows.name: Ushka ko-Kharrow
rows.derivation: bible example first name; a former memory-keeper

rows.name: Orrik ko-Kharrow
rows.derivation: orr 'bone' + -ik; went into the Oskeld shaft after his sister

rows.name: Ghorr
rows.rule: 5.3: clusters gh, rr; clan names are short
rows.derivation: gh- + orr 'bone': the Bone Clan, the eighth verse missing from the Rope-Song

rows.name: Mullbourne
rows.derivation: mull 'soft soil' + -bourne 'stream' — the soft ground of the quiet hamlet

rows.name: Harewell
rows.derivation: hare + -well: the well with a hare cut on its lip

rows.name: Larkstead
rows.derivation: lark + -stead; a quiet hamlet on the Roll

rows.name: Gosford
rows.derivation: gos 'goose' + -ford; the hamlet that stopped sending a cart in Y.T. 981

rows.name: Cille
rows.derivation: the Harewell hedge-honey seller nobody can picture

rows.name: Annet
rows.derivation: the writer of the Greyfold letter

rows.name: Ellen
rows.derivation: her sister at Gullhithe

rows.name: Mother Oss
rows.rule: 5.1 people: short form with an honorific
rows.derivation: Greyfold; whose idea the laid tables were

rows.name: Hob Larkin
rows.derivation: Hob (§5.1 first names); lark + -in. The unreliable hunter

rows.name: Tansy Cresswell
rows.derivation: from the POI registry (Foxglove Dell); made Nell Harebell's cousin by this stream

rows.name: Nauve Mor
rows.derivation: bible example; the salt-trader who wrote the Salt Isles guide

rows.name: Brannock
rows.derivation: a dead pilgrim at Pilgrim's Ash, named once by Aud Fennick

rows.name: M. Tarrow
rows.derivation: the Merrowby carter fined four marks in the Lantern Row day-book

rows.name: J. Wick
rows.derivation: the Gullhithe fisher fined forty marks for the same offence; kin to Tamsin Wick

rows.name: Greatsnail
rows.derivation: Winnow Pennywort's league leader; 'Second Greatsnail' is a post, not a snail

rows.name: Fast Colin
rows.derivation: a snail that is not fast; that is the joke

rows.name: Bramble
rows.derivation: Robin Ashdown's dog

rows.name: The Grafted Tree
rows.derivation: Bessa Tamwick's tree carrying eleven dead varieties

rows.name: The Toll's Lip
rows.rule: named for the feature it is built into
rows.derivation: the Merrowby inn whose cellar is the inside of the bell

rows.name: Aldous Hollin
rows.derivation: Aldous (a Vale name kept old in the Wold) + hollin 'holly', the root used bare as a Woodfolk surname

rows.name: Cille Tamwood
rows.derivation: Cille (feminine -e; the Harewell honey-seller carried it too) + tam 'oak' + wood, a tree-town surname

rows.name: Dorrie Cooper
rows.derivation: Tamwick-born; Cooper is a Vale trade surname, which is why the Hollow still calls her the Tamwick woman

rows.name: Gil Larkfold
rows.derivation: Gil (short Vale masculine) + lark + -fold, a Woodfolk surname from a clearing where larks were penned in story

rows.name: Edric Fletcher
rows.derivation: namegen candidate (seed 11); Fletcher is the trade, which in the Wold is the whole name

rows.name: Tansy Thornby
rows.derivation: Tansy (a Vale plant name) + thorn + -by 'village': a family named for a thorn-village on the Briar side

rows.name: Fenwick Collier
rows.derivation: Fenwick (fenn + -wick, a Vale given name from a place) + Collier, the charcoal-burner's trade

rows.name: Pip Hollin
rows.rule: 5.1 people: child's short name, family root surname
rows.derivation: Pip, a Vale pet-name; Hollin as her grandfather's

rows.name: Tam Larkfold
rows.rule: 5.1 people: root used as a given name
rows.derivation: tam 'oak' as a boy's name (bible example Tam ko-Rudd); Larkfold as his father's

rows.name: Rosen Wyke
rows.derivation: Ros- stem + -en; Wyke as Alder Wyke's, her father

rows.name: The Knot-Hearth
rows.rule: named for the feature it is built into
rows.derivation: the Hollow's hearth in the biggest knot of the Grandfather's trunk; the Woodfolk's inn insofar as they have one

rows.name: Mella Lissa
rows.rule: 5.4 people: soft, vowel-final, doubled consonant for length; second name from a marsh word
rows.derivation: namegen candidate (seed 11); Mella (doubled -ll-) + lissa 'reed'

rows.name: Issa Mor
rows.rule: 5.4 people: doubled consonant, marsh-word second name
rows.derivation: Issa (from isse 'water', bible example Issa Tal) + mor 'eel': the eel-wife's name is her trade

rows.name: Auti Sa
rows.rule: 5.4 people: vowel-final given name; second name taken with the bench
rows.derivation: namegen candidate Auti + sa 'lantern', the lantern-maker's name taken with her mother's bench

rows.name: Loa Oul
rows.derivation: Loa (soft, open) + oul 'deep pool', Tallissa Oul's family

rows.name: Mia Mor
rows.rule: 5.4 people: child's short vowel-final name, family second name
rows.derivation: namegen candidate; Mor as her grandmother Issa's

rows.name: Ollo Nauve
rows.rule: 5.4 people: doubled consonant; the Landing's own family name
rows.derivation: Ollo (doubled -ll-) + nauve 'channel'; the boatwright line Nauve's Landing is named for

rows.name: Sia Nauve
rows.rule: 5.4 people: vowel-final, married into the Nauve name
rows.derivation: Sia (sibilant, open) + Nauve

rows.name: Alle Nauve
rows.derivation: namegen candidate Alle + Nauve, her father's

rows.name: Stays
rows.derivation: Alle Nauve's name for the Said bridge at Nauve's Landing that stayed where the channel did not

rows.name: Greyheron
rows.derivation: the name Alle Nauve chalks for the player: walks as if unsure of the ground, and herons never fall in

rows.name: Torkh ko-Kharrow
rows.rule: 5.3 people: kh cluster, first-syllable stress, clan after ko-; a name that comes with a duty (3.4)
rows.derivation: namegen candidate (seed 11); the Moot-Speaker's name, carried with the speaking-bone

rows.name: Skardd ko-Skarl
rows.rule: 5.3 people: sk onset, dd coda, clan after ko-
rows.derivation: namegen stem Skardd + Skarl, the clan that by custom keeps another clan's gate

rows.name: Ghan ko-Oskel
rows.rule: 5.3 people: gh onset, short word, clan after ko-
rows.derivation: namegen stem Ghan + Oskel, the clan of the singing mine; an Oskel at a Kharrow hearth

rows.name: Kun ko-Rudd
rows.rule: 5.3 people: short word, u vowel, clan after ko-
rows.derivation: namegen stem Kun + Rudd, the clan Kharrow owes for the winter of the long snow

rows.name: Oskarth ko-Brindle
rows.rule: 5.3 people: Osk- onset, th coda, clan after ko-
rows.derivation: namegen stem Oskarth + Brindle, the mining clan of Brindlecrag

rows.name: Brodd ko-Brindle
rows.rule: 5.3 people: br onset, dd coda, clan after ko-
rows.derivation: namegen candidate (seed 11)

rows.name: Ghalorn ko-Rudd
rows.rule: 5.3 people: ghal 'chain' as onset, clan after ko-
rows.derivation: namegen candidate (seed 11); a Rudd among Brindles

rows.name: Toren Ash
rows.rule: 5.1 people: masculine -en; the Order's taken surname (3.6, Cadwen Ash)
rows.derivation: born Toren Tamwick at the cider press, Bessa's brother; Ash as every Toll-Knight takes when they swear

rows.name: Wat Thatcher
rows.rule: 5.1 people: short Vale masculine, trade surname
rows.derivation: namegen candidate Wat + Thatcher, his old trade at Larkbourne Ford

rows.name: Deseith
rows.rule: 5.2: open syllables, -eth ending; a pilgrim's taken name
rows.derivation: namegen candidate (oroth, seed 3); the name a Tollmere clerk says he heard in the note under the Seat

rows.name: Nan Greyfold
rows.rule: 5.1 people: short Vale feminine; a place taken as a surname
rows.derivation: Nan, a Vale pet-name; Greyfold, the dead village's name, taken because nobody else would carry it

rows.name: Jory Wick
rows.rule: 5.1 people: short Vale masculine; place-suffix surname (3.2 Lakefolk)
rows.derivation: namegen candidate Jory + Wick, Tamsin Wick's family; the J. Wick of the Lantern Row day-book

rows.name: Lettie Wick
rows.rule: 5.1 people: feminine -ie; married into a lake surname
rows.derivation: namegen candidate Lettie; Merrowby-born, a midwife's daughter, Wick by marriage

rows.name: Elsie Wick
rows.derivation: namegen candidate Elsie + Wick, her father's

rows.name: Hob Tamwick
rows.rule: 5.1 people: short Vale masculine; the orchard's place-name as a surname
rows.derivation: namegen candidate Hob + Tamwick, as his sister Bessa's: tam 'oak' + -wick 'dwelling'

rows.name: Orm Hollin
rows.rule: 5.1 people: short Vale masculine -orm root; the family the barrow is named for
rows.derivation: namegen root orm + hollin (holly), as Hollin Barrow; his wife Maud and son Ansel take Vale first names already in use, which is how Vale naming works

rows.name: Halloran Ash
rows.rule: 5.1 people: masculine -an; the grey name every Toll-Knight takes on swearing
rows.derivation: hal- (as Hallam) + -oran; Ash is the Order's surname, not a family's

rows.name: Reff
rows.derivation: Greyfold's smith, first of the forty-one Nan Greyfold says in order

rows.name: Cessa
rows.derivation: cress (a Valish root) worn down; the Greyfold woman whose bee-skep Nan still turns twice a year

rows.name: Wyle
rows.derivation: wyn (meadow) worn down; Old Wyle of Greyfold

rows.name: Skarrn
rows.rule: 5.3 people: cluster sk-, short, stress on the first syllable; no ko- name, because he has none
rows.derivation: skerr (broken stone) + -n; cut out of Clan Ghast, so the clan name that would follow ko- is gone, which is the whole of what a clanless name is

rows.name: Sa'lissa
rows.rule: 5.4 people: the glottal apostrophe appears only in names of the drowned
rows.derivation: sa (lantern) + lissa (reed), a lantern-maker's child; the apostrophe is the mark, as in Sa'oul

rows.name: Lissane Sa
rows.rule: 5.4 people: Lissane is a bible example; second name from the §5.4 list
rows.derivation: named in the POI registry (the Lantern Causeway's lamplighter); sa 'lantern'

rows.name: Khath ko-Rudd
rows.rule: 5.3 people: kh cluster, vowel a, th coda; ko- and the clan
rows.derivation: Kh + a + th; clan Rudd, a Rudd keeping the near end because no clan keeps its own gate

rows.name: Calen Ash
rows.rule: 5.1 people: cal- + masculine -en; the Tolling Order's sworn surname
rows.derivation: born Calen Cresswell in Tollmere; every knight of the Order takes Ash

rows.name: Ivo Goslin
rows.derivation: named in the POI registry (Willow Isle's hermit); Ivo and Goslin from the §5.1 lists

rows.name: Marigold Orchard
rows.derivation: Marigold and Orchard from the §5.1 lists; a Tamwick orchard woman on the pilgrim road

rows.name: Sorrel Rooke
rows.derivation: Sorrel and Rooke from the §5.1 lists; the day burner at the Charcoal Camp

rows.name: Barnaby Rooke
rows.rule: 5.1 people: a name used for anyone, family surname
rows.derivation: Barnaby from the §5.1 lists; Sorrel's brother, the night burner

rows.name: Ruska ko-Dreugh
rows.rule: 5.3 people: sk cluster, vowels u and a, stress on the first; ko- and the clan
rows.derivation: R + u + sk + a; clan Dreugh, who sit by the door at the Moot because they always leave first (skerrow.json), keeping the gate at Windgate

rows.name: Gisel Morneth
rows.rule: 3.2 Lakefolk: Valish first name, Oroth loanword surname
rows.derivation: gis- + feminine -el; surname morn 'stone' + -eth, a Tollmere family's Oroth name, as Sulion and Ondrael are

rows.name: Harl Mullen
rows.rule: 5.1 people: one-syllable Vale masculine; surname from the place
rows.derivation: Harl; Mullen from mull 'soft soil', the miller of Mullbourne on the leaf of the Roll in Hollin's bell (core:book/wardens_roll_fragment)

rows.name: Tessa Mullen
rows.derivation: the miller's wife on the same leaf

rows.name: Aldo Penfold
rows.derivation: penny 'small' + -fold 'pen': the carter of the ford road on the same leaf

rows.name: Fenn
rows.derivation: the widow on the same leaf, whose first name the Rest has lost

rows.name: Wennick Anthar
rows.rule: 3.2 Lakefolk: Valish first name, Oroth loanword surname
rows.derivation: wen- + masculine -ick; surname anthe 'choir' + -ar, taken off a lintel in the Undercroft by his great-grandmother (his own account)

rows.name: Ashwell
rows.derivation: ash + -well: the first well north of the ash, where the Larkbourne comes back

rows.name: Wynstead
rows.derivation: wyn 'meadow' + -stead: the drowned water-meadows; the Steward's family name

rows.name: Cressbourne
rows.derivation: cress + -bourne 'stream': the watercress coombe

rows.name: Fallowfold
rows.derivation: fallow + -fold 'pen': the shepherds' fold on the grey border

rows.name: Bramcombe
rows.derivation: bram 'bramble' + -combe 'valley'

rows.name: Rookdown
rows.derivation: rook + -down 'chalk hill': the rookery on the Brow

rows.name: Hazelcombe
rows.derivation: hazel + -combe: the hurdle-makers' valley

rows.name: The Hare and Hurdle
rows.derivation: the downs' coaching inn, named for its sign

rows.name: Hushwatch
rows.derivation: the stones where the Vale watches the Hush

rows.name: Southcote
rows.derivation: the family of the Last Field: south + cote

rows.name: Dunn
rows.derivation: the man on the Hare and Hurdle's board whom nobody remembers; Skerrish dun is 'remembered'

rows.name: Thistle
rows.derivation: Gil Fallow's grey ewe

rows.name: Ada Welling
rows.rule: 5.1 people: bible first name; trade surname
rows.derivation: the well-warden: Welling from the well she keeps

rows.name: Hal Wynstead
rows.derivation: the sluice-keeper, Ellard Wynstead's cousin

rows.name: Lin Cresswell
rows.derivation: cress + -well; Tobin Cresswell's cousin

rows.name: Gil Fallow
rows.rule: 5.1 people: bible first name; place-root surname
rows.derivation: the head shepherd of Fallowfold

rows.name: Pell Brambling
rows.rule: 5.1 people: bible first name and surname
rows.derivation: Maud Brambling's brother, who stayed on the downs

rows.name: Tor Rookwright
rows.derivation: rook + wright: Rookdown's reeve

rows.name: Tam Withy
rows.rule: 5.1 people: bible first name; trade surname
rows.derivation: withy 'willow rod': the master weaver of Hazelcombe

rows.name: Cal Merriweather
rows.derivation: keeper of the Hare and Hurdle

rows.name: The Last Camp
rows.derivation: the camp on the rim for the ones who have decided

rows.name: The West Walk
rows.derivation: the Order's post on its west walk, Ossel's forge

rows.name: Vaelost
rows.derivation: the kept one: the Builders' tower in the Ashgrid

rows.name: Anthe-Thael
rows.derivation: anthe 'choir' + thael 'door': the Sayers' name for the Anthem Hall

rows.name: Hesk Pool
rows.rule: 5.2 Oroth root with a Valish word
rows.derivation: hesk 'silence': the pool that gives back no reflection

rows.name: Ashcombe
rows.derivation: ash + -combe (bible example): the hamlet that went quiet in the Ash Winter and is remembered by nobody

rows.name: Greywatch
rows.derivation: the stones on the rim where the names are read

rows.name: Nella Candlewright
rows.derivation: candle + wright: the candle-maker of the Last Camp

rows.name: Merrit Ash
rows.rule: 5.1 people: Mer- stem; the Order's surname
rows.derivation: the Toll-Knight of the west walk

rows.name: Stride's Foot
rows.derivation: the south end of the Long Stride

rows.name: Sedgehithe
rows.derivation: sedge + -hithe 'landing': the reed-cutters' landing

rows.name: Merrowhithe
rows.derivation: merrow 'calm water' + -hithe: the quietest shore of the Mere

rows.name: Gull Holm
rows.derivation: the gulls' islet in the Mere

rows.name: Pellow
rows.derivation: the Tallyman whose summer house was never finished

rows.name: Corin Stilyard
rows.rule: 5.1 people: namegen first name; trade surname
rows.derivation: stilyard, a steelyard: the senior toll-clerk at the Stride's Foot

rows.name: Maudie Punt
rows.derivation: the head reed-cutter of Sedgehithe

rows.name: Berrit Smoker
rows.derivation: the smokehouse master of Merrowhithe

rows.name: Moreva
rows.derivation: mor 'eel' + -eva: the eel-landing

rows.name: Saeva
rows.derivation: sa 'lantern' + -eva: the lantern-makers' landing

rows.name: Nauvissa
rows.derivation: nauve 'channel' + -issa: the grey reed-beds on the Greyreed

rows.name: Oulea
rows.derivation: oul 'deep pool' + -ea: the salt pans on the tideflats

rows.name: Mor'oul
rows.rule: 5.4: the glottal apostrophe only in names of the drowned
rows.derivation: mor 'eel' + oul 'deep pool': the drowned stilt-village

rows.name: Mormere
rows.rule: Valish rendering of a Sedgish root
rows.derivation: mor 'eel' + -mere: the marsh mere by Moreva

rows.name: Lissane Mere
rows.rule: 5.4 example name with a Valish word
rows.derivation: the mere of the Long Jetty

rows.name: Sauve Mor
rows.rule: 5.4 people: soft vowel-final name + family word
rows.derivation: the eel-trapper of Moreva, Issa Mor's cousin

rows.name: Tella Oul
rows.rule: 5.4 people: soft, vowel-final, doubled consonant for length; family second name
rows.derivation: Tella (doubled -ll-, cf. Mella) + oul 'deep pool', Tallissa Oul's family: Moreva's night-watch for the Reed Council

rows.name: Lisse Tal
rows.derivation: the lantern-maker of Saeva

rows.name: Ossa Lissa
rows.derivation: the reed-cutter at the head of Nauvissa

rows.name: Meo Sa
rows.derivation: the salt-boiler of Oulea

rows.name: Elderhold
rows.rule: 3.5 Woodfolk: old Valish roots with -hold, as Fernhold
rows.derivation: elder + -hold: the lodge in the elder ring

rows.name: Rookhold
rows.derivation: rook + -hold: the Old Gate's keepers

rows.name: Hazelwick
rows.derivation: hazel + -wick 'dwelling': the coppicers' hamlet

rows.name: Ormhold
rows.derivation: orm + -hold: the northernmost lodge

rows.name: Countwatch
rows.derivation: the tower where the Briar's grey patches are counted

rows.name: Barkbridge
rows.derivation: the roofed bridge over the Wold Water

rows.name: Mossgrave
rows.derivation: the burial ground under named moss

rows.name: Wenna Holt
rows.derivation: the keeper of Elderhold

rows.name: Edda Thornby
rows.derivation: Tansy Thornby's aunt, eldest keeper at Rookhold

rows.name: Aggie Coppice
rows.derivation: the coppice-reeve of Hazelwick

rows.name: Nessa Ashby
rows.derivation: the keeper of Ormhold who guided the Listeners

rows.name: Ruddow
rows.derivation: Rudd + -ow: Clan Rudd's hold

rows.name: Ghastfell
rows.derivation: Ghast + -fell: Clan Ghast's hold by the broken bridge

rows.name: Dreughow
rows.derivation: Dreugh + -ow: Clan Dreugh's painted doors

rows.name: Skarlow
rows.derivation: Skarl + -ow: Clan Skarl's hold facing east

rows.name: Oskelcrag
rows.derivation: Oskel + -crag: the mining clan's village on the old spoil

rows.name: Ghorrow
rows.derivation: Ghorr + -ow: the eighth hold, of the clan with no verse

rows.name: Old Eld
rows.derivation: the first silver working on Brindle Edge

rows.name: Aske
rows.rule: 5.3 people: short, stress on the first syllable
rows.derivation: the Oskel child who walked up the mine road in her sleep

rows.name: Ushra ko-Rudd
rows.derivation: the memory-keeper of Clan Rudd

rows.name: Dagga ko-Ghast
rows.rule: 5.3 people: clusters gh, gg; ko- + clan
rows.derivation: the ladder-warden of Ghastfell

rows.name: Brann ko-Dreugh
rows.derivation: the door-painter of Dreughow

rows.name: Varra ko-Skarl
rows.derivation: the herd-mother of Skarlow

rows.name: Ebba ko-Oskel
rows.derivation: the lead-captain of Oskelcrag

rows.name: Saoul
rows.rule: 5.4 places: -oul 'deep pool'; the bible's own example
rows.derivation: sa 'lantern' + oul 'deep pool': the lantern-pool, named for Sa'oul, who is in it

rows.name: Sulion
rows.rule: 5.2 Oroth: open syllables, -ion; the bible's own example
rows.derivation: sul 'light' + -ion: the dead city's harbour light

rows.name: Hesk-Morn
rows.rule: 5.2 Oroth compound, modifier second; the bible's own example
rows.derivation: hesk 'silence' + morn 'stone': the Silent Door on the cliff

rows.name: Ghastfoot
rows.derivation: the Ghast clan's arch at the foot of Ghast Dale
